purpose: Semantic visual patterns chosen by the reader's analytical question. Check minimum_inputs before use; must_show items must be visible in the rendered page; avoid lists the most likely misreadings.

patterns.intent: Expose a meaningful simultaneous divergence or trade-off
patterns.best_for: Two compatible facts pointing in different directions
patterns.composition: Parallel evidence cards with a common baseline, one visual emphasis per card, and a unifying conclusion
avoid: juxtaposing incomparable percentage bases as if additive
patterns.discussion_hook: Which dimension should influence our judgment?

patterns.intent: Decompose a change from start to end into signed drivers
patterns.best_for: Additive contributions using the same unit and disjoint categories
patterns.composition: Common zero baseline or cumulative steps; sorted major positive and negative contributions; final total anchored
patterns.discussion_hook: Which driver is responsible for most of the change?

patterns.intent: Make the transformation from a flow to its retained amount tangible
patterns.best_for: Cash inflow minus cash outflows with consistent definitions
patterns.composition: Aligned paired waterfalls or equation bars for old and new periods; identical numeric scale
avoid: mixing company CapEx including leases with cash PP&E purchases
patterns.discussion_hook: What changes in the cash retained, not only in the amount generated?

patterns.intent: Compare changes over time while preserving distinct metrics
patterns.best_for: Two or more trends on separate but aligned panels
patterns.composition: Aligned time axes, consistent ordering, direct-end labeling
patterns.discussion_hook: Are the two trends converging, diverging, or moving together?

patterns.intent: Highlight a before-after movement
patterns.best_for: Paired observations per category
patterns.composition: Two aligned vertical axes; connecting slopes where category tracking matters
avoid: confusing relative percentages with percentage points
patterns.discussion_hook: Which item changed most significantly?

patterns.intent: Identify the few most important categories
patterns.best_for: Ranking a common measure
patterns.composition: Sorted horizontal marks with direct values, highlight only focus items
patterns.discussion_hook: Where is intervention most consequential?

patterns.intent: Communicate a part-of-whole relationship
patterns.best_for: Mutually exclusive exhaustive categories
patterns.composition: Single 100% stacked horizontal bar or proportion display plus absolute total
patterns.discussion_hook: Which share dominates and what does that imply?

patterns.intent: Show variation, tails and outliers
patterns.best_for: Individual observations beyond a mean
patterns.composition: Box / dot plot with median and spread labeled
patterns.discussion_hook: Are extreme cases driving the result?

patterns.intent: Separate alternative explanations from known facts
patterns.best_for: Exploratory root-cause analysis
patterns.composition: Rows of hypotheses by evidence columns; symbols or words for support / contradiction / unknown
patterns.discussion_hook: Which evidence would distinguish the competing explanations?

patterns.intent: Make a specific choice deliberable
patterns.best_for: Actionable alternatives evaluated against explicit criteria
patterns.composition: Comparable option columns with assumptions, benefits, costs, and triggers
patterns.discussion_hook: Which option do we adopt, and what evidence would cause us to revisit it?

patterns.intent: Explain a system or dependency chain
patterns.best_for: Stages, responsibilities or observable leading/lagging indicators
patterns.composition: Left-to-right stages with explicit arrow semantics and evidence per stage
patterns.discussion_hook: At which stage is the chain unverified or weakest?

patterns.intent: Communicate uncertainty without hiding it
patterns.best_for: Scenario forecasts and estimate ranges
minimum_inputs: range or clearly labeled direction-only bound
patterns.composition: Range or threshold with nominal/bound markers; future data visually separated
avoid: drawing open-ended > values as exact points
patterns.discussion_hook: What risk matters if the outcome is outside the expected range?

patterns.intent: Explain what is observed and what remains unknown
patterns.best_for: A conclusion with differentiated evidentiary strength
patterns.composition: Three tiers: observed / supported interpretation / unresolved assumption
avoid: pretending that absence of evidence is evidence of absence
patterns.discussion_hook: What could make our present inference wrong?

patterns.intent: Show completed, underway and forecast milestones distinctly
patterns.best_for: Event sequences and future commitments
patterns.composition: Single continuous axis with past versus future distinction and annotated events
avoid: nonlinear spacings on a linear timeline
patterns.discussion_hook: What is the next observable checkpoint?

patterns.intent: Contrast nominal growth with company-defined FX-adjusted growth while respecting methodological limits
patterns.best_for: Manufacturers with sizable international revenue and published currency-adjusted growth
patterns.composition: Two aligned comparable scales or diverging measures with prominent FX-adjusted figure
avoid: claiming difference in percentage points is an exact cash FX contribution
patterns.discussion_hook: How much growth reflects underlying activity rather than translation?

patterns.intent: Reveal whether revenue growth translates into profit while respecting segment definitions
patterns.best_for: Manufacturing businesses with both segment sales and segment profits
patterns.composition: Matched revenue and segment-profit deltas, followed by explicit segment margin shift
must_show: segment metric not confused with group operating income
patterns.discussion_hook: What prevents incremental sales from converting into profit?

patterns.intent: Decompose the net sales change by geography
patterns.best_for: Regions with a complete additive reconciliation
patterns.composition: Additive shares for positive major contributors and an explicitly labeled net-other segment
avoid: presenting a net remainder as all positive markets
using market revenue shares as growth contributions
patterns.discussion_hook: How concentrated is the period growth and what reversals could matter?

patterns.intent: Show revision between dated company outlooks while keeping forecasts separate from actuals
patterns.best_for: A new forecast versus a prior forecast with same fiscal scope
patterns.composition: Old-to-new revised forecasts with upward/downward direction marks consistent with sign
patterns.discussion_hook: What must hold for the upgraded forecast to be delivered?

patterns.intent: Identify when top-line and profit trends separate between reporting periods
patterns.best_for: Quarterly sales and operating profit growth with aligned comparison periods
patterns.composition: Small multiples with matched positions and one contrasting result highlight
avoid: mixing quarterly and H1 in the same series
patterns.discussion_hook: Did the quality of growth deteriorate in the recent quarter?

patterns.intent: Show revenue growth and operating-profit growth going in different directions
patterns.best_for: Comparable revenue and operating profit for two periods
minimum_inputs: revenues and operating profits by period
patterns.composition: Diverging comparison bars with a common axis, followed by a clearly labeled margin comparison
avoid: negative bars to the right of zero
patterns.discussion_hook: Which additional data would change the judgment?

patterns.intent: Prevent a sales increase from being misattributed to unit demand
patterns.best_for: Manufacturer sales and consolidated shipment-volume trends
patterns.composition: Two high-priority, independent metric cards plus an explicit question about price, mix, and exchange effects
avoid: calling volume a cause without verification
patterns.discussion_hook: Which additional data would change the judgment?

patterns.intent: Reconcile the reported start-to-end operating-profit change
patterns.best_for: Signed operating-profit factor bridge
patterns.composition: Vector waterfall with correctly connected cumulative steps
patterns.discussion_hook: Which additional data would change the judgment?

patterns.intent: Contrast business units without falsely adding incompatible results
patterns.best_for: Segment performance metrics across the same periods
minimum_inputs: segment profits for at least two segments
patterns.composition: Side-by-side normalized-to-prior panels with one common scale and explicit scope footnote
patterns.discussion_hook: Which additional data would change the judgment?

patterns.intent: Contrast operating, pretax and owners profit without treating them as synonyms
patterns.best_for: Different accounting profit tiers within one financial report
patterns.composition: Equal-width comparison rows with clearly labeled accounting tiers
avoid: representing final profit growth as an operating performance proof
patterns.discussion_hook: Which additional data would change the judgment?

patterns.intent: Display forecast alongside historical facts without category confusion
patterns.best_for: Management earnings guidance with YoY changes
patterns.composition: Forecast cards with visible status label and directional metrics
avoid: extrapolating Q1 mechanically to the full year
patterns.discussion_hook: Which additional data would change the judgment?

patterns.intent: Show where work accumulates along a process and how it relates to stage capacity
patterns.best_for: Multi-stage flow lines where WIP concentrates at one or more stages
minimum_inputs: WIP per stage on one good-unit basis
effective capacity and actual output per stage per day
patterns.composition: Stages left-to-right in material order; queue bars above each stage; effective capacity versus actual output marks on a shared rate axis; the constraint candidate emphasised
must_show: same unit basis for every stage
avoid: calling the largest queue the proven root cause
nameplate capacity shown as achievable output
mixing units and hours across stages
patterns.discussion_hook: Is the queue caused by capacity, release policy or batching, and what data would tell them apart?

patterns.intent: Reconcile opening and closing WIP through releases, completions and exits
patterns.best_for: Explaining why WIP rose or fell over a period
patterns.composition: Waterfall from opening to closing stock with signed flow steps; residual shown explicitly if conservation does not close
avoid: mixing period averages with point-in-time stock
patterns.discussion_hook: Which flow, releases or completions, should change to move closing WIP?

patterns.intent: Expose aged work that totals and averages hide
patterns.best_for: Queues where a long tail of old lots matters for delivery or quality
patterns.composition: Stacked or small-multiple bars per location by age band; oldest band emphasised; delivery-risk threshold marked if one is agreed
must_show: age at snapshot, not cycle time
location totals reconciling to WIP total
avoid: calling snapshot age a measured lead time
patterns.discussion_hook: Which aged lots need a disposition decision now?

patterns.intent: Compare inventory or WIP interventions without hiding delivery damage
patterns.best_for: Choosing among release-control, capacity and combined options
minimum_inputs: baseline and at least two intervention scenarios
capacity and release assumptions per scenario
patterns.composition: One row per scenario with aligned columns for WIP, delivered output, delivery gap and key assumption; the recommended scenario marked as conditional
must_show: service gap next to inventory benefit
avoid: showing WIP reduction without service impact
book value reduction shown as cash released
patterns.discussion_hook: Which option reduces WIP without breaking delivery, and under what guardrails?

patterns.intent: Connect a hypothesised constraint to a guarded pilot with explicit stop conditions
patterns.best_for: Requesting approval for a pilot when the root cause is not yet proven
patterns.composition: Left: evidence and competing explanation; centre: proposed intervention; right: go, stop and rollback criteria with owners
avoid: a pilot without a rollback condition
patterns.discussion_hook: What evidence would authorise the pilot, and what result would stop it?

patterns.intent: Explain the gap between planned and actual contribution by customer and SKU
patterns.best_for: Monthly plant or business reviews with customer-SKU price and variable cost data
minimum_inputs: planned and actual contribution per customer-SKU
price, volume and variable-cost components or a declared residual
definition of contribution versus operating profit
patterns.composition: Waterfall from planned to actual contribution with the largest customer-SKU drivers, remaining items grouped and labelled as net
must_show: contribution (限界利益) label, not operating profit
signed drivers reconciling to the gap
patterns.discussion_hook: Which customer-SKU gaps are recoverable next month, and which are structural?

patterns.intent: Show component requirements under explicitly conditional demand definitions
patterns.best_for: When it is unknown whether prior-period backlog is inside the next-period forecast
minimum_inputs: net build per SKU for each case
the open condition that separates the cases
patterns.composition: Two side-by-side cases with identical layout: demand, net build, component need, usable supply and shortage; the unresolved condition stated above both
must_show: the condition that decides which case applies
that the cases are alternatives, not additive
procurement decision on hold until resolved
avoid: presenting one case as the answer
hiding components with no supply record
patterns.discussion_hook: Who confirms the backlog treatment, and by when, before material is ordered?

patterns.intent: Compare finished-goods stock with upcoming demand without presuming excess
patterns.best_for: Inventory adequacy discussions where no agreed stock target exists, or to test against one
minimum_inputs: next two periods of distinct forecast
stock target or replenishment lead time if available
patterns.composition: Per-SKU bars of FG stock against stacked next-period and following-period demand; target band only if documented
must_show: quality-held or allocated stock separated if known
target source, or the statement that none is agreed
avoid: labelling stock as excess or obsolete without an agreed policy
one-month cover as the only test
patterns.discussion_hook: Which SKUs need a stock target decision before production is cut or increased?
